summary: Tested Crew Assignment (Jobs page) and Schedule page, backend and UI. Core flows work: the Crew column and jobs-crew-btn appear on every row, crew-modal chips toggle and save and the counts update, the Schedule nav link and week strip (7 days) work, prev/next/Today work, schedule-add -> use job's crew -> notes -> save puts the entry in day detail and the strip counts, edit notes works, remove works, other days show the empty state. Backend: crew filtering of IDs from other companies and invalid IDs works, schedule upsert is idempotent (same date+job = one entry), date-range listing works, DELETE works, employee gets 403 and an assignment notification is created. Found 1 critical regression (editing a job wipes its crew), 2 functional bugs (timezone date keys; editing an entry's date copies it instead of moving it) and robustness issues (500 on malformed ObjectIds, invalid dates accepted).

critical.issue: Editing a job through the Jobs edit modal wipes assigned_employees/vehicles/equipment. CrudManager.save only sends the JOB_FIELDS keys, the Job Pydantic model defaults assigned_* to [], and update_item $sets the full model_dump(). Reproduced via API (test_job_edit_preserves_crew.py) and in the UI (Downtown Reno 1·1veh·1eq -> 0·0·0 after Edit+Save).

minor.issue: A malformed ObjectId (e.g. 'bad') returns 500 (bson InvalidId is not caught). Should return 400/404.
date is not validated: 'not-a-date' is accepted and stored with 200. Use a date type or a YYYY-MM-DD regex.
Schedule entries for a deleted job are not removed, so orphan entries show as 'Job' with no name on the Schedule page.

ui_bugs.issue: iso() uses d.toISOString() (UTC). In the US after ~7-8pm local time, the 'today' highlight in WeekStrip moves to tomorrow (verified: NY 8:30pm Nov 6 -> 2026-11-07). In UTC+13 zones (NZ), the selected day at local noon maps to the previous date, so entries are created and filtered on the wrong day (verified: Auckland noon Nov 6 -> 2026-11-05). Build YYYY-MM-DD from getFullYear/getMonth/getDate instead.

When editing an entry, the date input can still be changed, but the upsert key is date+job. Saving creates a second entry on the new date and leaves the original in place (verified: Wed and Thu both had the entry). Either disable the date when editing, or delete the old entry / update by id.
No loading state: 'None added yet.' shows while /employees, /vehicles and /equipment are still loading, which misleadingly says there are no resources (seen on the first test run).
The close (X) button has no data-testid. The CrewModal Cancel button has no data-testid.

issues: Uses a native <select> and a native date input, unlike the shadcn Select/Calendar components. Minor visual inconsistency on a dark theme.

action_items: HIGH: Stop the job edit from wiping crew. Either have update_item use payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True), or have CrudManager send the assigned_* fields, or exclude the assigned_* fields in the generic update.
HIGH: Replace the toISOString-based iso() in Schedule.js and ScheduleParts.js with a local-date formatter.
MEDIUM: Fix schedule edit when the date changes (disable the date when editing, or move the entry by id).
Catch InvalidId -> 400/404 in assign_crew, upsert_schedule and delete_schedule (and generic CRUD).
Validate the schedule date format. Clean up schedule entries when a job is deleted.
Show a loading state in the PickList while resources load.
critical_code_review_comments: crud_router.update_item overwrites any field not in the client payload with model defaults. This is a general risk for every resource whose model has fields the form doesn't send.
ObjectId(...) is called on raw path/body strings without validation, giving 500s.
server.py is 1220 lines and should be split into routers (crew/schedule could be their own module).
useResources() makes 3 requests every time a modal opens, with no caching.

success_rate.backend: 77% (14/18; the 4 failures are 1 critical regression and 3 robustness edge cases)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (all requested flows pass; edit-wipes-crew regression, timezone bug and edit-date duplicate found)

rca of the issue: Crew wipe: Jobs.js -> CrudManager.save builds the payload from fields.map(f.key), so the assigned_* keys are missing. Job(BaseModel) fills them with [], and update_item does $set: payload.model_dump(), which overwrites them. Repro: assign crew -> Edit job -> Save -> Crew column shows 0. Fix: model_dump(exclude_unset=True) in update_item.
